blurb: Guests pilot their own Rubba Duck watercraft during a fun-filled, interactive 2.5 hour guided tour of Lake Havasu. The tour includes views of the London Bridge, Bridgewater Channel, Copper Canyon, and replicas of great lake lighthouses. No boating experience is needed as staff provide instruction and a guide leads the way.
